reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report on the page, with bisglycinate and a dose I can check. $24.99 for the first box is fair to try once, and the empty-box guarantee lowers the risk.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and I want to open the actual lab report and see that the batch number matches before I trust it. I also don't know yet if it will help my levels.
would_change_my_mind: If the report on the page turned out to be generic, not for my batch, or the lab was not a real independent one, I would pass.
